[[Frostfire Dryder]]s are common throughout the frozen tunnels of the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]]. They can make life difficult for groups not prepared with hex removing skills.

==Notes==
*There are a few Frostfire [[:Category:Dryder bosses|Dryder bosses]] that do not possess special names like most bosses. They are still discernible by having a higher level and the boss-like aura. They have been seen with any core class boss auras.
*The Frostfire Dryder uses the same model/skin as a [[Terrorweb Dryder (silver)]].
